description: CREATE VIEW, SELECT from simple and join views, DROP VIEW, and catalog introspection
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_view_patients (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INT);
CREATE TABLE diff_view_appointments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, patient_id TEXT, doctor TEXT);
INSERT INTO diff_view_patients (id, name, age) VALUES ('p1', 'Ada', 36), ('p2', 'John', 45);
INSERT INTO diff_view_appointments (id, patient_id, doctor) VALUES ('a1', 'p1', 'Dr. Rao'), ('a2', 'p2', 'Dr. Kim');
CREATE VIEW diff_patient_names AS SELECT id, name FROM diff_view_patients;
SELECT id, name FROM diff_patient_names ORDER BY id;

CREATE VIEW diff_patient_appointments AS SELECT diff_view_patients.name AS patient_name, diff_view_appointments.doctor AS doctor FROM diff_view_patients JOIN diff_view_appointments ON diff_view_patients.id = diff_view_appointments.patient_id;
SELECT patient_name, doctor FROM diff_patient_appointments WHERE doctor = 'Dr. Rao';
SELECT table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_name = 'diff_patient_names';
SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'diff_patient_names' ORDER BY ordinal_position;
SELECT relname, relkind FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE relname = 'diff_patient_names';
